posts.title: AI and Existential Dread
posts.description: There's a lot of polarising discourse right now about the threat AI poses to humanity. Some think it's a farce and others think we face extinction. Here are my thoughts.

posts.title: A Realisation About Fitness
posts.description: No matter how much I run, or how much I lift weights, it never gets easier. There's always a part of me that wants to stop, and there's always another part of me fighting to push through. This is how I deal with that internal battle.

posts.title: What does Quitting the Rat Race Mean to Me?
posts.description: Am I going to move to a cave in the mountains and immediately get eaten by a bear? This is what 'quitting the rat race' means to me.
